title: Tilt and iSpindel Gravity Delta
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:fermentation
| stats avg(tilt_sg) as tilt_sg, avg(ispindel_sg) as ispindel_sg by batch_name
| eval sg_delta=round(abs(tilt_sg-ispindel_sg),3)
| where sg_delta>0.004
| sort - sg_delta
description: Uses Dual-sensor fermentation batches telemetry to monitor gravity agreement between Tilt and iSpindel readings in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for batches where at least one sensor is drifting, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Dual-sensor fermentation batches data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Batch table of gravity delta between sensors.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges gravity agreement between Tilt and iSpindel readings so you can spot batches where at least one sensor is drifting before it becomes annoying.
